exercises.q: I didn't know that you were related.
exercises.ru: Я не знал, что вы в ___.
exercises.why: **родстве** — родство́: relationship, kinship, affinity (family relationship through marriage of a relative); kin; consanguinity, cognation; connection, connexion. Wiktionary: род + -ство.
exercises.context: One family: which of its words fits?
